newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta sets C$350 mln 6.125 pct bond due 2001.
newsitem.headline: Alberta sets C$350 mln 6.125 pct bond due 2001.

text.p: The province of Alberta on Wednesday set a C$350 million, 6.125 percent bond due October 4, 2001, said lead manager RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
The issue was priced at C$98.76 with a yield 6.418 percent with a spread of just six basis points over the Government of Canada 7.0 percent bond due September 1, 2001.
The issue, which will be delivered on October 4, 1996, pays interest on April 4 and October 4.
